raw.query: SELECT t.lead_s, ROUND(t.cost_ratio::numeric, 4) as toto_cost, ROUND(tf.cost_ratio::numeric, 4) as timesfm_cost, ROUND(((t.cost_ratio - tf.cost_ratio) / tf.cost_ratio * 100)::numeric, 2) as pct_spread FROM (SELECT lead_s, cost_ratio FROM v_cost_ratio WHERE experiment = 'factorial' AND window_name = 'aggregate' AND forecast_model = 'toto' AND run_id LIKE '%_p90_%' AND run_id LIKE '%_rho15_%' AND denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8') t JOIN (SELECT lead_s, cost_ratio FROM v_cost_ratio WHERE experiment = 'factorial' AND window_name = 'aggregate' AND forecast_model = 'timesfm' AND run_id LIKE '%_p90_%' AND run_id LIKE '%_rho15_%' AND denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8') tf ON t.lead_s = tf.lead_s WHERE t.lead_s <= 45 ORDER BY t.lead_s;
raw.observed: [L=15s: Toto 0.6137, TimesFM 0.5993 (spread 2.41%); L=30s: Toto 0.6096, TimesFM 0.5949 (spread 2.47%); L=45s: Toto 0.6054, TimesFM 0.5904 (spread 2.54%)]
raw.claimed: Toto and TimesFM pass at the same service floor across the realizable-lead range, within the <=4% cross-model cost spread.
raw.evidence: Across all evaluated realizable leads (15s, 30s, 45s) on the 5.60-day aggregate window, both models achieve the zero-queueing service floor (588.37 ms p99 encoder delay) with cross-model cost spreads of 2.41%, 2.47%, and 2.54% (all <=4%).
